propositions: merge.ours.driver is set per clone in init.py but never committed, so reconcile-bridge.yml runner does not inherit the configuration
Without merge.ours.driver defined, git silently falls back to 3-way text merge of the 18.2 MB bridge_state JSON file instead of local-wins behavior
reconcile-bridge.yml must explicitly set merge.ours.driver=true before any merge step on the tickets worktree, whereas reconcile-bridge-canary.yml already obtains it via rebar init
blob:none filtering requires merge-base blobs to be materialized during reconverge, so undefined merge driver causes lazy faults and conflicts mid-merge
The configuration must be validated via unit workflow-lint tests and integration tests confirming local-wins resolution without text-merge markers
